fixture_setup_corrections: Private TMUX_TMPDIR under this long worktree exceeds the Unix-domain path limit; the supported fm-lab-home.sh tmux-dir helper supplied short private sockets and teardown removed them.

The unchanged summary regression initially rejected a child nested under the real code root. Copying only its script and shared helpers to a disposable sibling code root (with real bin symlinked) restored supported isolation; it then passed.
Gate SessionStart wrappers intentionally stand down, so disposable Claude settings invoked the real public digest directly; no gate bypass was used.
The full owned-history proof ran the real writer in Claude SessionStart to inherit the actual private-pane TMUX; its ledger records endpoint exists=true.
